```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# position table, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
# The position path is a contract-checked pipeline target, read from the
# targets store rather than the DuckDB (decision 0041).
pp <- targets::tar_read(position_path, store = file.path(root, "_targets"))
```

```{r}
#| label: stages
# Each stage counts the college athlete ids that can be placed at it; a stage is
# a subset of the one above except the three link methods, which split the
# linked recruits.
n_all <- nrow(pp)
method_count <- function(m) sum(pp$hs_linked & pp$hs_link_method %in% m, na.rm = TRUE)
stages <- tibble::tribble(
  ~stage,                                    ~players,                                ~linked,
  "All college athletes",                    n_all,                                   FALSE,
  "Linked to a high school recruit",         sum(pp$hs_linked),                       TRUE,
  "   by the same name",                     method_count("name"),                    TRUE,
  "   by a name variant",                    method_count("name_variant"),            TRUE,
  "   by school and class year",             method_count("school_year"),             TRUE,
  "High school position recorded",           sum(pp$hs_linked & !is.na(pp$hs_group) & pp$hs_group != "Position not recorded"), FALSE,
  "College position recorded",               sum(pp$college_groups > 0),              FALSE,
  "Drafted",                                 sum(pp$drafted),                         FALSE,
  "Linked to an NFL draft record",           sum(pp$nfl_linked),                      FALSE,
  "NFL position recorded",                   sum(!is.na(pp$nfl_group)),               FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    stage = factor(stage, levels = rev(stage)),
    share = players / n_all,
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: %s athlete ids (%.1f%% of the roster ids)",
      stage,
      formatC(players, big.mark = ",", format = "d"),
      100 * share
    ),
    label = sprintf(
      "%.1f%% (%s)",
      100 * share,
      formatC(players, big.mark = ",", format = "d")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# How far each stage reaches into the roster: the link stages are the ones
# that let a position be compared across sources.
p <- ggplot(stages, aes(100 * share, stage)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(fill = linked, tooltip = tip, data_id = as.character(stage)),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.05, size = 4.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#374151", `FALSE` = "gray70")) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x),
    limits = c(0, 175),
    breaks = c(0, 50, 100)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Athletes placed at each linkage stage",
    subtitle = "Share of all college athletes; dark: linked to a recruit",
    x = "Share of all college athletes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "position-linkage-funnel", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```
